jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
ABOUT COGENT

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent’s "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.



To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality.



Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.



We’re backed by Greylock and we’ve built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

 - Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

 - Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

 - World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

 - Preeminent research labs like Deepmind and SAIL




ABOUT THE ROLE 

As a Business Operations Associate, you’ll operate as a true generalist working directly with company leadership on the most important problems facing the business at any given time.

This is a highly dynamic, high-ownership role. One quarter you might be focused on operational reviews, the next on talent initiatives or building Cogent’s external presence. The common thread is: you’ll work on whatever matters most to moving the company forward.

The role offers rare exposure to how a category-defining company is built end to end, making it a strong fit for someone excited by company-building and long-term leadership growth.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with founders and company leaders to drive high-priority strategic and operational initiatives

 - Drive the operational engine behind our research initiatives, including standing up strategic partnerships to create benchmarks and RL environments

 - Stand up our QA function from the ground up 

 - Own product operations: translate customer requirements into buildable specs and manage the ticket pipeline between pre and post sales asks 

 - Step into new strategic priorities as they emerge, taking ownership and driving them to impact




ABOUT YOU

 - 2+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, product management, or early-stage startup / founder roles

 - Highly comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with minimal structure

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with excellent judgment

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

 - Strong relationship-builder who works well across technical and non-technical teams 

 - High ownership mindset with a bias towards action

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent's "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.



To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.



We're backed by Greylock & Bain Capital Ventures, and we've built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

 - Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

 - Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

 - World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

 - Preeminent research labs like DeepMind and SAIL




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Analyst, Strategic Finance to own our financial model and the analysis behind how the company plans, forecasts, and invests. The role spans the five-year operating model, headcount planning, core SaaS metrics, board materials, and GTM finance - including sales capacity modeling, pipeline analytics, and commission design. You'll report to the Head of Finance & Operations and work directly with the CEO and sales leadership. This is hands-on work and a strong fit for someone making a move from banking or an MBB environment into an operating company; the role grows into leading the strategic finance function.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the five-year operating model and run the annual and quarterly planning process

 - Collaborate across the business to design hiring plans and build the three-statement forecast supporting lender and covenant reporting

 - Own the sales capacity model; partner with GTM leadership on quota setting, territory and segment planning, and pipeline analytics

 - Design and support commission plans; support pricing and packaging decisions with analysis

 - Own core SaaS metrics: ARR, net revenue retention, pipeline coverage, sales efficiency, CAC payback, burn multiple, and gross margin

 - Build dashboards and self-serve reporting for the leadership team; support board meeting preparation

 - Use AI tooling to build models, analyses, and internal reporting tools; apply AI workflows to accelerate forecasting, variance analysis, and ad hoc requests




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2-6 years of experience in investment banking, management consulting, or a comparably analytical finance role

 - Ability to build and maintain a P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow forecast from scratch

 - Strong quantitative judgment; you can explain complex analysis concisely to executives

 - Strong financial modeling abilities

 - Comfortable with broad scope and shifting priorities at an early-stage company




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, or early-stage operating work

 - Experience partnering with GTM teams on capacity planning or pipeline analytics

 - Hands-on with AI tools for modeling, reporting, or internal tooling



We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. Field is already a major pipeline engine for us, and we are hiring a Field Marketing Manager to help scale that motion with sharp execution, creativity, and operating leverage.

This role sits within the Demand Generation arm of Growth and partners closely with Sales, SDR, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and RevOps. The mandate is to help turn regional programs, executive events, partner activations, and big industry moments into qualified meetings, pipeline, and stronger account relationships.

This is a hands-on execution role with real leverage. In the first few months, you will help build the field marketing operating system: event calendar, target-account planning, pre/post-event workflows, rep and partner coordination, follow-up SLAs, AI-powered logistics tracking, and reporting that shows which programs create real pipeline.




OWNERSHIP AREAS




FIELD STRATEGY AND PROGRAM PLANNING

 - Help build regional and account-based field plans aligned to pipeline targets, priority accounts, sales territories, and partner opportunities.

 - Support the right mix of executive roundtables, dinners, roadshows, conferences, partner activations, customer/prospect events, and VIP experiences.

 - Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect field programs to digital, content, outbound, and nurture so programs are amplified before and after the event.

 - Maintain a field calendar, program briefs, account lists, meeting goals, budgets, and success metrics.


EVENT EXECUTION AND EXPERIENCE

 - Run end-to-end execution for assigned field programs: planning, logistics, venues/vendors, invitations, on-site experience, materials, speaker coordination, and follow-up.

 - Make every event feel high-quality, intentional, and connected to the Cogent brand.

 - Coordinate tightly with AEs, SDRs, Partnerships, and leadership so target accounts are invited, followed up with, and converted into meetings and opportunities.

 - Help build repeatable playbooks, workflows, and AI-assisted tracking systems so we can manage logistics, tasks, vendors, follow-up, and reporting across more programs without reinventing the process every time.


PIPELINE IMPACT AND PARTNER ACTIVATION

 - Track event performance across registration, attendance, target-account engagement, meetings, SQLs, pipeline, deal acceleration, and ROI.

 - Partner with RevOps to keep attribution, campaign membership, follow-up, and pipeline reporting clean.

 - Support co-marketing and channel activations with partners, including regional programs, deal-registration follow-up, spiffs, and better-together stories.

 - Use AI and automation to improve event research, targeting, personalized outreach, logistics tracking, task management, post-event follow-up, recap assets, and reporting.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 2-4+ years in field marketing, event marketing, partner marketing, demand generation, or marketing/program operations in B2B SaaS or technology; cybersecurity interest or experience is a plus.

 - Experience supporting or running events, webinars, field programs, or partner activations tied to pipeline goals.

 - Strong project manager who can keep logistics, vendors, budgets, calendars, stakeholders, and follow-up moving.

 - Comfortable working directly with Sales and SDR teams on target accounts, invite lists, event conversion, and follow-up.

 - Good taste for customer/prospect experience and brand quality; detail-oriented enough to make programs feel polished.

 - Curious with data: willing to inspect registration, attendance, meetings, pipeline influence, ROI, and what to repeat or stop.

 - AI-forward operator who looks for ways to automate research, outreach, logistics tracking, workflows, recaps, and reporting without losing quality.

 - Willingness to travel for events and field activations as needed.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Cogent is building the revenue engine for autonomous cyber defense, and we are hiring a Performance Marketing Lead to build the digital demand engine that turns the right audiences, messages, and moments into sales-qualified pipeline.

This role sits on the Growth team and partners closely with Demand Generation, Content, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, RevOps, and agency partners. You will build the performance engine across paid distribution, landing pages, conversion paths, webinars, nurture, attribution, and campaign learning so our best ideas reach the right buyers and convert.

We are looking for someone creative, analytical, operational, and AI-native: a builder who can launch programs quickly, make their own assets when needed, use data to decide what to scale, and help a lean Growth team move like a much larger one.




WHAT YOU WILL DO




BUILD DIGITAL PIPELINE

 - Run paid search, LinkedIn, retargeting, sponsored content, webinar promotion, and other digital programs that create qualified demand.

 - Test audiences, segments, offers, messages, creative, and landing pages with a clear view of what creates Sales-accepted meetings and sales-qualified pipeline.

 - Build campaigns around priority ICP segments, industries, competitors, use cases, field moments, and market signal.

 - Optimize for lead quality, conversion, pipeline, and spend efficiency, not vanity metrics.


OWN LANDING PAGES AND CONVERSION

 - Build and improve campaign pages, webinar pages, comparison pages, category pages, and conversion paths.

 - Improve CTAs, forms, page structure, routing, retargeting, and follow-up so more of the right traffic becomes qualified demand.

 - Partner with Content and PMM on SEO/AEO topics, then own the conversion layer that turns that traffic into pipeline.

 - Maintain enough CMS, Webflow, Framer, or light HTML/CSS fluency to unblock yourself.


RUN WEBINARS AND DIGITAL PROGRAMS

 - Own webinars, virtual roundtables, and digital programs as pipeline programs, from promotion to follow-up.

 - Partner with PMM, Content, Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, and founders on topics, speakers, audience, registration, and activation.

 - Turn each program into a follow-up engine: nurture, retargeting, SDR handoff, sales snippets, and landing-page updates.

 - Measure registrations, attendance, engagement, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline created, and pipeline influenced.


BUILD NURTURE AND AUDIENCE ACTIVATION

 - Build nurture programs that move the right buyers from interest to sales conversation.

 - Segment audiences by persona, account fit, industry, intent, source, engagement, and lifecycle stage.

 - Partner with the SDR/outbound motion on hot-lead workflows, follow-up plays, and messaging tests.

 - Use campaign learnings to inform where Growth should spend, what messages are working, and which audiences are converting.


OWN MEASUREMENT AND CAMPAIGN OPS

 - Set up clean UTMs, campaign tracking, form flows, routing, HubSpot attribution, and reporting for your programs.

 - Report weekly on traffic quality, conversion, qualified leads, Sales-accepted meetings, sales-qualified pipeline, CAC, and learnings.

 - Work with RevOps to understand where demand is converting, where it is leaking, and what to test next.

 - Keep programs moving without waiting on a separate admin for every campaign ops change.


BUILD AI-NATIVE PERFORMANCE WORKFLOWS

 - Use AI to accelerate research, campaign briefs, landing page drafts, creative variants, webinar ops, nurture, reporting, and analysis.

 - Create lightweight digital assets yourself using AI and design tools, and use agency support when the work needs heavier polish.

 - Experiment with AI agents and automation to monitor market signal, identify campaign ideas, and turn those ideas into programs quickly.

 - Bring strong judgment and taste to AI output. Speed matters, but credibility matters more.\




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in performance marketing, digital demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated campaigns, ideally in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or another technical category.

 - Hands-on experience with paid search, paid social, retargeting, webinars, landing pages, nurture, campaign ops, and conversion optimization.

 - Strong analytical instincts. You can explain what happened, why it happened, and what to do next.

 - Comfortable in tools like HubSpot, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Search Console, Ahrefs, Semrush, Webflow, Framer, or similar.

 - Good creative taste and enough design fluency to make or direct digital assets for ads, webinars, landing pages, and nurture.

 - Strong collaborator with Content and PMM, with the ability to turn strong stories into high-performing campaigns, landing pages, and conversion paths.

 - AI-native operating style. You use AI every day to move faster and build better systems.

 - High ownership, low ego, fast follow-through, and real curiosity about cybersecurity.
